photosUnavailableBody: Prepare the selected photos again and retry the original request. Your notes and assessment permission stay with this draft.
watchCommittedBody: Your draft is still here. Retry once the existing sale or service commitment ends, or check the original request before closing it.
signInBody: Use your marketplace account. The server checks your current permissions and represented organization on every request.
unavailableBody: No change was confirmed. Retry with the same request when the service recovers.
deniedBody: This account is not currently permitted to open these records.
stale: This record changed. Refresh it before making another change.
emptyBody: This is a live empty queue, not a sample decided case.
custodyHint: Without a verified custody receipt, this record stays awaiting intake. No watch is marked received.
diagnosisAllowed: Diagnostic opening is permitted for this received watch.
diagnosisNotAllowed: Diagnostic opening is not authorized by this record.
scopePolicy: Reported symptoms are not a diagnosis. Saving does not book a visit, confirm receipt or authorize work. Execution requires accepted scope, current custody and platform-held simulated payment.
permission: I permit only the selected assessment, not repair or polishing.
filesLimit: Private photos: up to ten files, 256 KiB each. Files stay in memory until explicitly submitted.
receiptMissing: No receipt is available for this operation. Check again or use the reference below when contacting support.
retrySame: The result is uncertain. Retry this exact action reference.
readFirst: Open an existing record or prepare a new intake.
finishWatchRequest: Resolve the current maintenance request before opening another watch.
safePhoto: I confirm these photos exclude identity documents, full serials and former-owner details.
requestSubmitted: Request submitted. Await business assessment; no visit is booked and no work is authorized.
legacyCurrency: This legacy currency record is read-only. Request explicit USD reissue; amounts cannot be converted here.
invalid: Check symptoms (1–2,000 characters), modifications (up to 2,000 characters), the supported assessment, permission and photo declaration. Use up to ten supported photos, each at most 256 KiB.
reviewRevision: Review the current record before keeping your draft changes.
keepDraft: Use this revision and keep my draft
reviewContextBody: The original operation has no recorded receipt. Review current watch and business scope before submitting your retained draft again. No booking or work is authorized.
adoptContext: Use reviewed scope and keep my draft
retainedDestination: This operation keeps its original business. Photos will be prepared again if the assessment scope changes.
chooseReplacement: Use the current scope to choose another business. Your notes and photos will stay in the draft.
noCurrentDestinations: There are no businesses currently offering an assessment for this watch. Check again later. Your draft is still open.
destinationUnavailable: The selected business currently has no supported assessment. Load current scope again later; your original operation and private files stay unchanged.
continueRequest: Sign in and continue maintenance request
signInFailed: Sign-in could not be confirmed. Check your details and retry the same action.
reviewChangedScope: The watch or assessment terms changed. Review the current scope and confirm your assessment permission again.
reconcileIntake: Use current custody, acknowledgements and fee, and keep my note edits
historicalReceipt: Custody receipt on file. Open the record to verify current custody.
custodyUnconfirmedBody: Enter the newer custody receipt issued for this order, then save the intake. Check current custody again if the receipt status changes.
custodyUnavailableBody: Retry the custody check before opening the watch.
conflictingNotes: These notes changed both here and in the saved record. Your draft values are shown below.
reconcileConflicts: Use saved values for conflicts and keep my other note edits
intakeReceiptMissing: No receipt is available yet. Check again using the same reference.
evidenceRecovered: Private file attached. Confirmed intake revision
closeUnconfirmed: Close this unconfirmed operation and start again
reviewLimitReached: The review limit was reached. Check the original receipt. If it is missing, close the operation before starting again.
openingAcceptanceReview: Review the current customer permissions and accepted assessment fee before recording them.
openingAcceptancePrepared: Current acknowledgements added to the draft. Save intake to record them.
discardPhotoAttempt: Remove photos and unlock this draft
awaiting_confirmation: The official brand has not confirmed the physical watch yet.
confirmed: The physical watch has been confirmed.
rejected: The request was closed after the watch could not be confirmed
assessmentCustodyChanged: Custody or assessment access changed. Review current custody before recording findings.
receiptRevisionPrepared: Receipt revision reviewed. Save intake to record it.
